skillDispatch.boundary: Only compiled skill component IDs leave pending totals. Source-current environment-gated NeverTrigger IDs and unmatched source-disabled skills remain pending and are deferred until a real entry is present. Executable-pending means eligible for shared-contract work, not directly ready to bind. Mode activation, other skills, source operators and whole-enemy completion remain separate.

periodicAbilities.boundary: These are compiled complete periodic ability groups, not EnemySkill components. Reuse their stable group IDs without redispatching them; keep the 27-skill cohort, other source operators and whole-enemy gaps unchanged. Capability bindings overlap on the same enemies and are not additive enemy coverage.
